rule.supported: The unmodified verbatim API passes result parity, replay, writes once, divergence-before-dispatch and tidy fixed refusals in both required lanes.
rule.alternative: Otherwise an async replacement passes those criteria for at least one journaled call per branch under shipped code in both required lanes; document the measured shape limits.
rule.alternativeDesign: Otherwise the test-only branch journal passes all eight criteria in both required lanes; recommend sequential acall loops today.
rule.refused: Otherwise record the failing probes and technical reason; sequential acall loops remain the author guidance.

predictions.singleCallGather: Result parity, replay, write identity and divergence-before-dispatch pass in every arrival order under shipped code.
predictions.multiCallGather: Shipped replay or re-dispatch fails unrecoverable in another order; the branch journal passes.
predictions.pauseInBranch: Shipped code may leave an unfinished journal or orphan sibling; the branch journal ends unsupported and drains siblings.
